name: Making Money
overview: Scripture teaches that making money is a gift and responsibility granted by God, who gives the power to gain wealth as part of His covenant faithfulness (Deuteronomy 8:18). Diligence and labor are emphasized as the means by which wealth increases, contrasting with the poverty that comes from laziness or empty talk (Proverbs 10:4; 13:11; 14:23). Furthermore, true riches come as a blessing from the Lord, which brings no sorrow, highlighting the importance of God’s favor over mere human effort (Proverbs 10:22). The wisdom of Scripture also acknowledges the realities of financial relationships, noting that debt places one in servitude to the lender (Proverbs 22:7).
